title: fix(plugin-detail): related table offers Export only to a reader who may export
body:
Fixes #30069

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:记录页「相关」页签里的表格,只有当读者在列表页也能看到「导出」时才显示「导出」;导出被服务器拒绝时,相关表格、列表页和表格视图三处都显示界面语言的提示,不再显示服务器的英文原句。
- 为什么改:同一个读者在商机列表页看不到「导出」,在客户记录的商机页签里却能看到,点了才收到一句英文报错,产品对同一权限说了两种话。
- 风险与回滚:只读权限缺省时(老后端、无权限提供者)仍显示按钮,行为与列表页一致;服务器照旧拦截导出。回滚即撤销本 PR,无数据或元数据迁移。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`(`exportPermitted` 一段与导出失败分支);`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` 与 `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` 的导出 catch。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.enlargedToolbar-27524.test.tsx`,预期 9 个测试全部通过,其中 4 个是本卡新加的(无导出权限不见按钮、有权限只导出本关系的行、中文界面下 403 显示中文、非拒绝类失败仍显示服务器原句)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The related table asks the list page's export question.** The enlarged related list (the record page's active tab) drew Export whenever its data source could export. It now also reads the child object's effective API operation set through `usePermissions().getObjectApiOperations`, the same source and the same default-allow rule as `ListView`'s `exportPermitted` (and `ObjectGrid`'s and `ReportExportControl`'s). A reader whose set leaves out `export` sees no Export; a missing set keeps the button, as on the list page. The export request itself is unchanged, so a reader who may export still exports this relation's rows alone (the parent scope, the list filter, the chip, the filter text and the order).
- **An export refusal reads in the Console's language, in every door that calls `exportDownload`.** The three doors are the related table, the list page and the grid. Each showed the thrown error's `message`, which for the export route's 403 is the server's English sentence ("Export is not permitted on object ..."). Each now asks the existing shared classifier `isPermissionError` from `@object-ui/react` (403, `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `FORBIDDEN`) and, when it answers true, shows the new `view.exportNotPermitted` sentence. Any other failure keeps the server's sentence.
- **`view.exportNotPermitted`** is added to all ten locale packs, and to the three packages' provider-less default maps, byte-identical to the `en` pack (the precedent is `view.malformedFilter`, one sentence shared by several surfaces).
- Landing point: the refusal is localized ui-side by status and code. The route sends a machine code (`EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED`) with status 403, so no server change is needed and `packages/**` is untouched.

## Tests

Run on head `31bb7e7cb`.

- `RelatedList.enlargedToolbar-27524.test.tsx` gains one top-level `describe` (the component's shared harness) with four cases under a real `MePermissionsProvider` and `I18nProvider`: a reader without `export` sees no Export and the export route is never called; a reader with `export` sees it and the request is scoped to the parent (`lead` = `L-1`); under `zh` a 403 `EXPORT_NOT_PERMITTED` shows the Chinese sentence and not the server's; a 504 control still shows the server's sentence.
- `ListView.test.tsx` and `exportServer.test.tsx` (grid): the existing "surfaces export failures" pins used `new Error('Permission denied')`, which is itself a refusal shape. They now use a 504 so they keep pinning "a failure is surfaced, not swallowed", and a refusal case beside each pins the Console sentence and the absence of the server's text.

## Acceptance notes

- The related table reads `apiOperations` of `api`, the object its export request is sent to, so the question and the request name the same object.
- Not changed: an export whose object has the operation switched off by its `enable` block (the `api-disabled` kind of `classifyLoadError`) is not a permission refusal, and it still shows the server's sentence in all three doors. Observation only, not measured against a running server.
- `ReportExportControl` builds its file in the browser and calls no export route, so it has no server refusal to localize.
